settings.fixed: current effective applied geometry, directional holds, original known-paper qualification

donor.qualification: every pixel in the frozen median-qualified known-paper mask
donor.signal: absolute original float Lab; no mean subtraction, clipping, offsets or noise

quilting.first_patch: nearest full-Lab mean to median known Lab within64px of component
quilting.cost: mean squared Lab overlap error plus .02 times reuse count
quilting.seam: minimum-error left and top cuts, retain old on either keep-old seam side

settings.matched: identical donor placement and raw source coordinates for observed_L and observed_Lab
settings.observed_L: replace only baseline float L with blended absolute donor L
settings.observed_Lab: replace all three channels with the same blended absolute donor Lab
settings.fallback: fewer than4 qualified24px patches: retain entire baseline; no gate/scale relaxation
settings.qualification_caveat: median qualification may admit individual raw outliers; not ink/damage ground truth
